result_preview.title: Vendor Material Invoice Management API
result_preview.shortDescription: Retrieves and manages vendor invoices linked to materials and purchase orders.
result_preview.description: This API exposes real-time access to vendor invoice records, material receipt confirmations, and invoice-to-PO matching data. It manages invoice status updates, payment terms, and vendor-specific billing information while providing integration points for goods receipt workflows and inbound logistics processes.

result_preview.title: Customer Account Financial API
result_preview.shortDescription: Retrieves and manages customer account financial data including balances and payment terms.
result_preview.description: This API exposes customer account financial information and order-related payment details, enabling retrieval of account balances, credit limits, and payment status. It manages customer financial profiles linked to their orders, providing access to aging analysis, credit adjustments, and transaction history for integrated financial accounting and receivables management.

result_preview.title: Procurement Spend Analytics
result_preview.shortDescription: Aggregated spend metrics and vendor performance trends across purchase orders and contracts.
result_preview.description: A derived analytical data product that consolidates procurement spend data across vendors, purchase orders, and active contracts. It provides pre-calculated KPIs including category spend distribution, vendor spend concentration, contract utilization rates, and period-over-period spend variance. This product enables procurement teams to identify optimization opportunities, monitor vendor performance, and support strategic sourcing decisions.
